ex.en: Variable names in C are case sensitive.
ex.zh: C 語言的變數名稱有區分大小寫。

ex.en: Declarations of variables are extremely important in C and C++.
ex.zh: 在 C 和 C++ 中，變數宣告非常重要。

variable.en: a quantity or symbol in math or computing that can take different values

ex.en: The weather here is highly variable.
ex.zh: 這裡的天氣變化很大。

ex.en: The restaurant's food quality is variable.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳的菜品質不太穩定。

variable.en: often changing, or able to be changed

ex.en: She would willingly come but she was on vacation.
ex.zh: 她很樂意來，可是她正在休假。

ex.en: When I go on vacation, I'll rent a car.
ex.zh: 我去度假的時候會租一輛車。

ex.en: Where are you going to go on your vacation?
ex.zh: 你放假打算去哪裡玩？

vacation.en: a period of time spent away from work or school for rest or travel

ex.en: They vacationed in France last year.
ex.zh: 他們去年到法國度假。

ex.en: We usually vacation in Hualien every summer.
ex.zh: 我們通常每年夏天都去花蓮度假。

vacation.en: to spend time away from work or home for rest or travel

ex.en: There were several rooms still vacant.
ex.zh: 還有幾間空房。

ex.en: Rooms should be left vacant by eleven a.m. on the day of departure.
ex.zh: 退房當天，房間須在上午十一點前清空。

ex.en: Excuse me, is this seat vacant?
ex.zh: 請問這個位子有人坐嗎？

vacant.en: empty and not being used by anyone

ex.en: The position has been vacant for two months.
ex.zh: 這個職位已經空缺兩個月了。

ex.en: We are looking for someone to fill the vacant post.
ex.zh: 我們正在找人填補這個空缺。

vacant.en: available because nobody is doing the job

ex.en: He was standing there with a vacant look.
ex.zh: 他站在那裡，一臉茫然。

ex.en: She gave me a vacant stare.
ex.zh: 她茫然地盯著我。

ex.en: The flowers will look more beautiful in the vase.
ex.zh: 把花插在花瓶裡會更好看。

ex.en: I must apologize to you for breaking the vase.
ex.zh: 很抱歉，我把你的花瓶打破了。

ex.en: You need to put more water in the vase.
ex.zh: 你需要在花瓶裡多加點水。

vase.en: a container, often made of glass, used to hold cut flowers

vacate.zh: 騰出、搬出、空出（房間、座位、職位）

ex.en: Guests must vacate their rooms by noon.
ex.zh: 房客必須在中午前退房。

ex.en: The tenants vacated the apartment last week.
ex.zh: 房客上週搬出了那間公寓。

vacate.en: to leave a place or job so that it is empty

ex.en: Please validate your email address to activate your account.
ex.zh: 請驗證你的電子郵件地址以啟用帳號。

ex.en: The data must be validated before the report is published.
ex.zh: 報告發布前必須先驗證資料。

ex.en: The system validates each password automatically.
ex.zh: 系統會自動驗證每組密碼。

validate.en: to check or prove that something is correct or acceptable

ex.en: She made a vanilla chocolate cake for four people.
ex.zh: 她做了一個四人份的香草巧克力蛋糕。

ex.en: I'd like a vanilla ice cream cone.
ex.zh: 我想要一支香草冰淇淋甜筒。

vanilla.en: a sweet-smelling flavor used in ice cream and cakes

variance.zh: 差異、變動；（預算與實際的）差額

ex.en: There is a large variance between the budget and actual costs.
ex.zh: 預算和實際成本之間有很大的差異。

ex.en: We need to explain any variance in the sales figures.
ex.zh: 我們需要說明銷售數字的任何差異。

variance.en: a difference between two things that should be the same

ex.en: His story is at variance with the facts.
ex.zh: 他的說法與事實不符。

ex.en: The results were at variance with our predictions.
ex.zh: 結果與我們的預測不一致。

ex.en: The startup reached a valuation of one billion dollars.
ex.zh: 這家新創公司的估值達到十億美元。

ex.en: We need a professional valuation of the property.
ex.zh: 我們需要請專業人員為這處房產估價。

valuation.en: a judgment of how much something is worth in money

ex.en: Please check the validity of your passport before you travel.
ex.zh: 出國前請確認你的護照是否還在有效期限內。

ex.en: The validity of the contract is two years.
ex.zh: 這份合約的有效期是兩年。

validity.en: the state of being officially acceptable and able to be used

ex.en: You can't deny the validity of everything she did just because of a single mistake.
ex.zh: 你不能只因為一個錯誤，就否定她所做的一切。

ex.en: Some experts question the validity of the survey results.
ex.zh: 有些專家質疑這份調查結果的正確性。

validity.en: the quality of being based on good reasons or facts

ex.en: There is a lot of variability in the test results.
ex.zh: 測試結果的變異很大。

ex.en: Weather variability makes farming difficult.
ex.zh: 天氣多變讓農業經營很困難。

variability.en: how much something changes or differs

ex.en: I haven't had the vaccine for Coronavirus.
ex.zh: 我還沒打過新冠病毒疫苗。

ex.en: Scientists are working on a new flu vaccine.
ex.zh: 科學家正在研發新的流感疫苗。

vaccine.en: a medicine given to the body to protect it from a disease

ex.en: She gave us a vague answer.
ex.zh: 她給了我們一個含糊的答案。

ex.en: This paragraph is vague.
ex.zh: 這一段寫得很模糊。

ex.en: She had a vague feeling of guilt.
ex.zh: 她隱約有一種罪惡感。

ex.en: As more paper money came into use, the value fell.
ex.zh: 隨著越來越多紙幣流通，幣值就下跌了。

ex.en: This picture frame can make the picture rise in value.
ex.zh: 這個畫框能讓這幅畫增值。

value.en: how much something is worth in money or importance

ex.en: Traditional values are relative.
ex.zh: 傳統價值觀是相對的。

ex.en: Our company values include honesty and teamwork.
ex.zh: 我們公司的核心價值包括誠信與團隊合作。

value.en: the beliefs about what is right and important in life

ex.en: She values health above wealth.
ex.zh: 她認為健康比財富更重要。

ex.en: He valued the professor's advice.
ex.zh: 他很重視教授的建議。

ex.en: I know that some people value my work.
ex.zh: 我知道有些人很看重我的工作。

ex.en: Japan imports various raw materials from abroad.
ex.zh: 日本從國外進口各種原料。

ex.en: Air is a mixture of various gases.
ex.zh: 空氣是各種氣體的混合物。

ex.en: He had various experiences in his life.
ex.zh: 他一生中有過各種經歷。

ex.en: There was a great variety of dishes on the menu.
ex.zh: 菜單上有各式各樣的菜色。

ex.en: This store has a variety of spices.
ex.zh: 這家店有各種香料。

ex.en: We talked about a variety of topics.
ex.zh: 我們聊了各種話題。

variety.en: the quality of being made up of many different things

ex.en: This is a new variety of apple.
ex.zh: 這是一種新品種的蘋果。

ex.en: Taiwan grows many varieties of tea.
ex.zh: 台灣種植很多品種的茶。

variety.en: a type of something that is different from others in the same group

ex.en: The price of gold varies from day to day.
ex.zh: 金價每天都在變動。

ex.en: Availability may vary by region and device compatibility.
ex.zh: 實際提供情況可能因地區和裝置相容性而有所不同。

ex.en: China's territory is vast, thus the types of tea vary.
ex.zh: 中國幅員遼闊，因此茶的種類各不相同。

vary.en: to change, or to be different in different situations

ex.en: The Sahara is a vast desert.
ex.zh: 撒哈拉是一片廣大的沙漠。

ex.en: A vast and sophisticated system is usually based on a few simple rules.
ex.zh: 龐大而精密的系統通常建立在幾條簡單的規則上。

ex.en: The vast majority of users like the new design.
ex.zh: 絕大多數使用者都喜歡新設計。

vast.en: extremely large in size or amount

ex.en: Real friendship is more valuable than money.
ex.zh: 真正的友誼比金錢更有價值。

ex.en: The computer is undoubtedly a valuable tool.
ex.zh: 電腦無疑是很有用的工具。

ex.en: Nothing is more valuable than good health.
ex.zh: 沒有什麼比健康更寶貴。

valuable.en: worth a lot of money, or very useful

ex.en: You should keep your valuables in a safe place.
ex.zh: 你應該把貴重物品放在安全的地方。

ex.en: Please don't leave valuables in your car.
ex.zh: 請勿將貴重物品留在車內。

valuable.en: things that are worth a lot of money, such as jewelry

ex.en: There is little variation in prices between the two stores.
ex.zh: 這兩家店的價格差異不大。

ex.en: Sales show a seasonal variation every year.
ex.zh: 銷售額每年都有季節性的變化。

variation.en: a change or difference in amount or level

ex.en: This dish is a variation of a traditional recipe.
ex.zh: 這道菜是傳統食譜的變化版。

ex.en: There are many variations of this game.
ex.zh: 這個遊戲有很多種玩法變化。

variation.en: a form of something that is slightly different from the usual one

ex.en: Tom was the last one to get in the van.
ex.zh: 湯姆是最後一個上廂型車的。

ex.en: A big van appeared on the street corner.
ex.zh: 街角出現了一輛大型廂型車。

ex.en: The delivery van arrived at noon.
ex.zh: 送貨車中午到了。

van.en: a covered road vehicle used for carrying goods or people

ex.en: Turn off the main water valve before fixing the pipe.
ex.zh: 修水管前先把總水閥關掉。

ex.en: The technician replaced a broken valve in the machine.
ex.zh: 技師更換了機器裡一個壞掉的閥門。

valve.en: a device that controls the flow of liquid or gas through a pipe

ex.en: My grandfather had surgery to repair a heart valve.
ex.zh: 我爺爺動了手術修補心臟瓣膜。

ex.en: Valves in the veins keep blood flowing in one direction.
ex.zh: 靜脈裡的瓣膜讓血液往單一方向流動。

valve.en: a flap in the body that lets blood flow in only one direction

ex.en: Scientists are studying a new variant of the virus.
ex.zh: 科學家正在研究這種病毒的新變種。

ex.en: The car comes in three variants.
ex.zh: 這款車有三種車型可選。

ex.en: "Colour" is the British variant of "color."
ex.zh: colour 是 color 的英式拼法。

variant.en: a form of something that is slightly different from others

ex.en: There are several variant spellings of the name.
ex.zh: 這個名字有好幾種不同的拼法。

ex.en: The study compared two variant forms of the gene.
ex.zh: 這項研究比較了該基因的兩種變異型。

variant.en: slightly different from the usual or standard form

ex.en: Have you had your flu vaccination this year?
ex.zh: 你今年打流感疫苗了嗎？

ex.en: Vaccination is free for children under six.
ex.zh: 六歲以下兒童可以免費接種疫苗。

vaccination.en: the act of giving someone a medicine to protect them from a disease

ex.en: Every Tuesday morning the housekeeper vacuums.
ex.zh: 每週二早上，管家都會用吸塵器打掃。

ex.en: The homemaker vacuumed the carpet.
ex.zh: 她用吸塵器清理地毯。

vacuum.en: to clean a floor using a machine that sucks up dirt

ex.en: I got this vacuum cleaner for nothing.
ex.zh: 這台吸塵器是我免費拿到的。

ex.en: I sucked up the dust on the floor with a vacuum cleaner.
ex.zh: 我用吸塵器把地上的灰塵吸乾淨。

vacuum.en: a machine that sucks up dirt from floors

ex.en: Sound cannot travel in a vacuum.
ex.zh: 聲音無法在真空中傳播。

ex.en: The coffee is sealed in a vacuum pack.
ex.zh: 咖啡用真空包裝密封。

vacuum.en: a space with no air or other matter in it

vain.zh: 徒然的、白費的（常用 in vain）

ex.en: All our efforts were in vain.
ex.zh: 我們所有的努力都白費了。

ex.en: All their efforts were in vain.
ex.zh: 他們的努力都白費了。

ex.en: Your death was not in vain.
ex.zh: 你沒白死。

vain.en: without success, so that the effort was wasted

ex.en: He is so vain that he checks his hair in every window.
ex.zh: 他愛慕虛榮到每扇窗戶都要照一下頭髮。

ex.en: She was too vain to admit she needed glasses.
ex.zh: 她太愛面子，不肯承認自己需要戴眼鏡。

vain.en: too proud of your own looks or abilities

ex.en: The girl vanished like magic.
ex.zh: 女孩變魔術一樣地消失了。

ex.en: He vanished without a trace.
ex.zh: 他消失了，不留一絲蹤跡。

ex.en: The bird vanished from view.
ex.zh: 鳥兒從我的視線中消失了。

ex.en: A beautiful valley lies behind the hill.
ex.zh: 小山後面有一座美麗的山谷。

ex.en: We went down to the valley where the village is.
ex.zh: 我們下到村莊所在的山谷。

ex.en: They marched northwest into the Shenandoah Valley.
ex.zh: 他們往西北方進軍，進入謝南多亞河谷。

valley.en: a low area of land between hills or mountains

ex.en: The form requires validation before submission.
ex.zh: 表格送出前必須先完成驗證。

ex.en: Data validation prevents many entry errors.
ex.zh: 資料驗證可以避免許多輸入錯誤。

validation.en: the act of checking or proving that something is correct

ex.en: Sorry, we have no vacancies tonight.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我們今晚沒有空房。

ex.en: The sign outside the motel said "Vacancy."
ex.zh: 汽車旅館外面的招牌寫著「有空房」。

vacancy.en: a room in a hotel that is free for a guest

ex.en: There is a vacancy in the sales department.
ex.zh: 業務部有一個職缺。

ex.en: We advertised the vacancy online last week.
ex.zh: 我們上週在網路上刊登了這個職缺。

vacancy.en: a job that is available for someone to take

ex.en: We gave our car keys to the valet.
ex.zh: 我們把車鑰匙交給代客停車的人員。

ex.en: Valet parking costs 20 dollars a night.
ex.zh: 代客停車一晚 20 美元。

valet.en: a person who parks cars for guests at a hotel or restaurant

ex.en: This passport is valid for five years.
ex.zh: 這本護照的有效期是五年。

ex.en: This ticket is valid for three days.
ex.zh: 這張票三天內有效。

ex.en: The special conditions will be valid until 2025.
ex.zh: 此特殊條件有效期限至 2025 年。

valid.en: officially acceptable and able to be used

ex.en: That's a valid point.
ex.zh: 你說得很有道理。

ex.en: She had a valid reason for being late.
ex.zh: 她遲到有正當的理由。

valid.en: based on good reasons and therefore acceptable

ex.en: The students have varying levels of English ability.
ex.zh: 學生們的英文程度各不相同。

ex.en: Prices change depending on varying market conditions.
ex.zh: 價格會隨著不斷變動的市場狀況而改變。

ex.en: The menu offers a varied selection of local dishes.
ex.zh: 菜單上有各式各樣的在地料理可選。

ex.en: She has a varied career in teaching and design.
ex.zh: 她的職涯多采多姿，橫跨教學與設計。

ex.en: The workers poured the grape juice into a huge vat.
ex.zh: 工人把葡萄汁倒進一個巨大的桶子裡。

ex.en: The cloth was dipped in a vat of blue dye.
ex.zh: 布料被浸入一大桶藍色染料中。

ex.en: I vaguely remember meeting her at a party years ago.
ex.zh: 我隱約記得多年前在一場派對上見過她。

ex.en: He answered vaguely, so nobody knew what he really thought.
ex.zh: 他回答得含糊不清，沒人知道他真正的想法。

ex.en: The children dressed up as a vampire for Halloween.
ex.zh: 孩子們在萬聖節扮成吸血鬼。

ex.en: In the old story, a vampire sleeps in a coffin during the day.
ex.zh: 在這個老故事裡，吸血鬼白天睡在棺材裡。

ex.en: The two cities are vastly different.
ex.zh: 這兩座城市大不相同。

ex.en: Her English has vastly improved this year.
ex.zh: 她的英文今年進步了非常多。

ex.en: Water vapour rose from the hot soup.
ex.zh: 熱湯冒出了水蒸氣。

ex.en: You could see the vapour from the kettle in the cold air.
ex.zh: 在冷空氣中可以看見水壺冒出的蒸氣。

ex.en: The bank keeps its gold in a strong vault.
ex.zh: 銀行把黃金存放在堅固的金庫裡。

ex.en: The thieves failed to break into the vault.
ex.zh: 小偷沒能闖進保險庫。

ex.en: The cathedral has a beautiful stone vault above the aisle.
ex.zh: 這座大教堂的走道上方有一座美麗的石造拱頂。

ex.en: The family kept their wine in an old cellar vault.
ex.zh: 那家人把酒存放在一個古老的地下室窖藏裡。

ex.en: He vaulted over the fence to catch the bus.
ex.zh: 他跳過圍籬去趕公車。

ex.en: The athlete vaulted over the bar with a long pole.
ex.zh: 那名運動員用長竿撐過了橫桿。

ex.en: Water vapor rose from the hot cup of tea.
ex.zh: 水蒸氣從熱茶杯裡升起。

ex.en: The mirror was covered with vapor after his shower.
ex.zh: 他洗完澡後，鏡子上蒙了一層水氣。

ex.en: From this vantage point, you can see the whole city.
ex.zh: 從這個有利的位置，你可以看到整座城市。

ex.en: Her experience gave her a vantage over the other candidates.
ex.zh: 她的經驗讓她比其他應徵者更占優勢。

ex.en: His vanity made him spend hours in front of the mirror.
ex.zh: 他的虛榮心讓他在鏡子前花好幾個小時。

ex.en: It was pure vanity that made her refuse to wear glasses.
ex.zh: 她不肯戴眼鏡純粹是出於愛慕虛榮。

variously.zh: 以不同方式；各式各樣地

ex.en: The creature is variously called a dragon or a lizard.
ex.zh: 這種生物被不同的人稱為龍或蜥蜴。

ex.en: The dish is variously made with rice, noodles, or bread.
ex.zh: 這道菜有時用米飯，有時用麵條，有時用麵包製成。

ex.en: The company is in the vanguard of green technology.
ex.zh: 這家公司站在綠色科技的最前線。

ex.en: The vanguard of the army reached the town first.
ex.zh: 軍隊的先頭部隊最先抵達小鎮。

ex.en: The Vatican is the smallest country in the world.
ex.zh: 梵蒂岡是世界上最小的國家。

ex.en: Millions of tourists visit the Vatican every year.
ex.zh: 每年有數百萬名遊客造訪梵蒂岡。

ex.en: He plays on the varsity basketball team.
ex.zh: 他是大學籃球代表隊的球員。

ex.en: She made the varsity squad in her first year.
ex.zh: 她大一就入選了校隊。

ex.en: The park was closed after an act of vandalism.
ex.zh: 公園在一起破壞公物事件後關閉。

ex.en: The city is trying to stop vandalism on public buses.
ex.zh: 市政府正試圖遏止公車上的破壞行為。

ex.en: A vandal painted graffiti on the school wall.
ex.zh: 有人在學校牆上亂塗鴉，故意破壞。

ex.en: The park keeper caught a vandal breaking the benches.
ex.zh: 公園管理員抓到一名故意破壞長椅的人。

ex.en: Smoking can increase the risk of vascular disease.
ex.zh: 吸菸會增加血管疾病的風險。

ex.en: The doctor is a specialist in vascular surgery.
ex.zh: 這位醫生是血管外科的專科醫師。

ex.en: Apply a coat of varnish to protect the wooden table.
ex.zh: 塗一層清漆來保護這張木桌。

ex.en: The old chair needed a fresh layer of varnish.
ex.zh: 那張舊椅子需要重新上一層清漆。

ex.en: He varnished the wooden floor over the weekend.
ex.zh: 他週末把木地板塗上了清漆。

ex.en: Let the boards dry before you varnish them.
ex.zh: 等木板乾了再上清漆。

ex.en: She received a valentine from a secret admirer.
ex.zh: 她收到一張來自神祕愛慕者的情人節卡片。

ex.en: The children made valentines for their classmates.
ex.zh: 孩子們為同學做了情人節卡片。

ex.en: Will you be my valentine this year?
ex.zh: 今年你願意當我的情人嗎？

ex.en: Vancouver is a port city on the west coast of Canada.
ex.zh: 溫哥華是加拿大西岸的一座港口城市。

ex.en: Many international students choose to study in Vancouver.
ex.zh: 許多國際學生選擇到溫哥華讀書。

ex.en: Our plans depend on the vagaries of the weather.
ex.zh: 我們的計畫取決於天氣的反覆無常。

ex.en: Investors worry about the vagaries of the market.
ex.zh: 投資人擔心市場的難以預料的變動。

ex.en: The vanishing forests worry many scientists.
ex.zh: 正在消失的森林讓許多科學家擔憂。

ex.en: The magician performed a vanishing trick with a coin.
ex.zh: 魔術師表演了用硬幣變不見的把戲。

ex.en: She is a valued member of our team.
ex.zh: 她是我們團隊中受重視的成員。

ex.en: Honest feedback is highly valued here.
ex.zh: 這裡非常重視誠實的意見回饋。

ex.en: The expert valued the painting at ten thousand dollars.
ex.zh: 專家把這幅畫估價為一萬元。

ex.en: He valued their friendship above everything else.
ex.zh: 他把他們的友誼看得比什麼都重要。

ex.en: The firefighters made a valiant effort to save the old house.
ex.zh: 消防員英勇地盡力搶救那間老房子。

ex.en: Despite a valiant fight, the team lost the match.
ex.zh: 儘管奮勇拚搏，球隊還是輸掉了比賽。

ex.en: Parents should vaccinate their children against measles.
ex.zh: 家長應該讓孩子接種麻疹疫苗。

ex.en: Nurses will vaccinate everyone in the school next week.
ex.zh: 護理師下週會替學校裡的每個人接種疫苗。

ex.en: Please do not leave valuables in the car.
ex.zh: 請不要把貴重物品留在車上。

ex.en: The hotel has a safe where guests can store their valuables.
ex.zh: 飯店有保險箱，讓房客存放貴重物品。

vagaries.zh: 難以預料的變化；反覆無常

ex.en: Farmers must deal with the vagaries of the weather.
ex.zh: 農民必須應付天氣難以預料的變化。

ex.en: He was tired of the vagaries of the stock market.
ex.zh: 他厭倦了股市的起伏不定。

ex.en: A vagrant slept on the bench near the station.
ex.zh: 一名流浪漢睡在車站附近的長椅上。

ex.en: The town gave food to every vagrant in winter.
ex.zh: 這座城鎮在冬天提供食物給每一位流浪者。

ex.en: He lived a vagrant life, moving from town to town.
ex.zh: 他過著居無定所的生活，一座城鎮換過一座。

ex.en: A vagrant dog followed us home.
ex.zh: 一隻流浪狗跟著我們回家。

ex.en: Her grandparents performed in vaudeville in the 1920s.
ex.zh: 她的祖父母在一九二〇年代的雜耍歌舞團表演過。

ex.en: The theater once hosted vaudeville acts every weekend.
ex.zh: 這間劇院過去每個週末都有雜耍歌舞表演。

ex.en: A valuer came to estimate the price of our house.
ex.zh: 一位估價師來評估我們房子的價值。

ex.en: The antique valuer checked the vase carefully.
ex.zh: 古董估價師仔細檢查了那只花瓶。

ex.en: In the Middle Ages, a vassal promised to serve his lord in war.
ex.zh: 中世紀時，封臣承諾在戰爭中效忠他的領主。

ex.en: The small kingdom became a vassal of its powerful neighbor.
ex.zh: 這個小王國成了強大鄰國的附庸。

ex.en: Water vaporizes when it is heated to a high temperature.
ex.zh: 水被加熱到高溫時會蒸發。

ex.en: The machine vaporizes the liquid into a fine mist.
ex.zh: 這台機器把液體汽化成細霧。

ex.en: The soldier received a medal for his valor.
ex.zh: 那位士兵因他的英勇而獲頒勳章。

ex.en: The firefighters showed great valor in saving the family.
ex.zh: 消防員在救出那家人時展現了極大的勇氣。

ex.en: The beach was crowded with vacationers in July.
ex.zh: 七月時海灘上擠滿了度假的人。

ex.en: Every vacationer at the hotel received a free map.
ex.zh: 飯店裡每位度假的客人都拿到一份免費地圖。

ex.en: The island is quiet in winter, when few vacationers visit.
ex.zh: 這座島在冬天很安靜，很少有度假的人來。

ex.en: The vanquished army retreated across the river.
ex.zh: 戰敗的軍隊撤退到河的對岸。

ex.en: The vanquished team shook hands with the winners.
ex.zh: 落敗的球隊和勝利者握了手。

ex.en: The magician's coin vanished into thin air.
ex.zh: 魔術師的硬幣憑空消失了。

ex.en: By the time we arrived, the crowd had vanished.
ex.zh: 等我們到達時，人群已經散去不見了。

ex.en: I was amazed by the vastness of the desert.
ex.zh: 我對沙漠的遼闊感到驚嘆。

ex.en: The vastness of space is hard to imagine.
ex.zh: 太空之浩瀚令人難以想像。

ex.en: The plant has variegated leaves with white edges.
ex.zh: 這種植物的葉子帶有白色邊緣的斑紋。

ex.en: A variegated cat sat on the fence.
ex.zh: 一隻花色斑駁的貓坐在籬笆上。

ex.en: The vagueness of his answer annoyed everyone.
ex.zh: 他回答的含糊讓大家都很不耐煩。

ex.en: I was bothered by the vagueness of the instructions.
ex.zh: 說明書的模糊不清讓我很困擾。

ex.en: The old church has a beautiful vaulted ceiling.
ex.zh: 那座老教堂有漂亮的拱形天花板。

ex.en: We walked through a long vaulted corridor to reach the library.
ex.zh: 我們穿過一條長長的拱頂走廊才到圖書館。

ex.en: He vainly tried to start the old car in the cold.
ex.zh: 他在寒冷的天氣裡徒勞地想發動那輛老車。

ex.en: She waited vainly for a reply to her letter.
ex.zh: 她白白等了很久，卻一直沒收到信的回覆。

ex.en: The weather vane on the roof turned toward the north.
ex.zh: 屋頂上的風向標轉向北方。

ex.en: The vanes of the windmill spun slowly in the breeze.
ex.zh: 風車的葉片在微風中緩緩轉動。

ex.en: The vaunted new phone turned out to be disappointing.
ex.zh: 那支被大肆吹捧的新手機結果令人失望。

ex.en: The team's vaunted defense failed in the final game.
ex.zh: 球隊引以為傲的防守在決賽中潰敗。
